description:
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying its mana cost plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters, its innate ability and its offspring ability trigger.
Resolve the innate Burning-Tree Emissary trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}
Resolve the offspring trigger, creating two token copies of Burning-Tree Emissary that are 1/1.
When the Burning-Tree Emissary tokens enter, they each trigger, adding six {R}.
Cast Appa by paying its mana cost plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Appa enters, its innate ability and its offspring ability trigger.
Resolve the innate Appa trigger, airbending the nontoken Burning-Tree Emissary.
Resolve the offspring trigger, creating two token copies of Appa that are 1/1.
Put both Appa tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Both Appa tokens' enter-the-battlefield ability trigger, airbending Appa with one trigger and nothing with the other.
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat steps 2 through 5 once.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat from step 7.

uses.name: Kaya, Geist Hunter
uses.cardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it
